description_en: Queries the list of client tasks
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-once-task --task-type CLIENT_PROBLEM_CHECK --root-task-id bb5d657479bba5e1d308b6c9e85c9174 --start-time-query 1651737301000 --end-time-query 1651766520000 --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --source console --task-id 'd7b2acf8d362742123e4a84e1bf8****' --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeOnceTask

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:
VUL_CHECK_TASK: vulnerability scanning task
CLIENT_PROBLEM_CHECK: client task
CLIENT_DEV_OPS: cloud O&M task
ASSET_SECURITY_CHECK: asset collection task
ASSET_REFRESH_HOST: host asset synchronization task
TaskType and RootTaskId cannot be empty at the same time. If neither is provided, the API returns HTTP 400 with the error code -101
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。取值：
VUL_CHECK_TASK：漏洞扫描任务
CLIENT_PROBLEM_CHECK：客户端任务
CLIENT_DEV_OPS：云运维任务
ASSET_SECURITY_CHECK：资产采集任务
ASSET_REFRESH_HOST：主机资产同步任务
TaskType 和 RootTaskId 不能同时为空，两者均未提供时 API 返回 HTTP 400，错误码为 -101
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The root task ID.
You can call the [DescribeOnceTask](~~DescribeOnceTask~~) operation and specify TaskType to query the root task list. You can obtain this parameter from TaskManageResponseList[].TaskId in the response.
TaskType and RootTaskId cannot be empty at the same time. If neither is provided, the API returns HTTP 400 with the error code -101
parameters.help_zh:
根任务ID。
您可以调用[DescribeOnceTask](~~DescribeOnceTask~~)接口，传入 TaskType 查询根任务列表，从返回的 TaskManageResponseList[].TaskId 获取该参数。
TaskType 和 RootTaskId 不能同时为空，两者均未提供时 API 返回 HTTP 400，错误码为 -101
parameters.name: root_task_id

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the root task starts. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 根任务开始的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time_query

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the root task ends. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 根任务结束的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time_query

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of client tasks per page for paging. Default value: 20, which indicates that each page contains 20 client tasks
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页包含的客户端任务的数量。默认值为20，表示每页包含20个客户端任务
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The source of the task. Valid values include but are not limited to:
schedule: automatic scheduling of vulnerability scanning
console: one-click detection in the vulnerability scanning console
parameters.help_zh:
任务来源。取值包括但不限于：
schedule：漏洞扫描自动调度
console：漏洞扫描控制台一键检测
parameters.name: source

schema.description_en: The response data for client tasks

Count.description_en: The number of client tasks displayed on the current page for paging
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页面显示的客户端任务条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page for paging
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of client tasks per page for paging. Default value: 20, which indicates that each page contains 20 client tasks
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含的客户端任务的数量。默认值为20，表示每页包含20个客户端任务

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of client tasks returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的客户端任务的总条数

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TaskManageResponseList.description_en: The list of returned information for the client task query
TaskManageResponseList.description_zh: 客户端任务查询的返回信息列表

items.description_en: The returned information for the client task query
items.description_zh: 客户端任务查询的返回信息

DetailData.description_en:
The task execution details. This parameter is in JSON format.

causeCode: The return code for the troubleshooting cause.
causeMsg: The return message for the troubleshooting cause.
resCode: The troubleshooting return code.
resMsg: The troubleshooting return message.
problemType: The problem type.
dispatchType: The task dispatch method.
uuid: The server UUID.
instanceId: The server instance ID.
internetIp: The public IP address of the server.
intranetIp: The private IP address of the server.
instanceName: The server instance name.
url: The download link for the troubleshooting log
DetailData.description_zh:
任务执行详情。该参数为JSON格式。

causeCode：排查原因返回码。
causeMsg：排查原因返回信息。
resCode：排查返回码。
resMsg：排查返回信息。
problemType：问题类型。
dispatchType：任务下发方式。
uuid：服务器UUID。
instanceId：服务器实例的ID。
internetIp：服务器外网IP。
intranetIp：服务器的私网IP地址。
instanceName：服务器实例的名称。
url：排查日志下载链接

Progress.description_zh: 任务进度，单位为百分比

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of successfully executed tasks

TaskEndTime.description_en: The timestamp when the task actually ends. Unit: milliseconds
TaskEndTime.description_zh: 任务实际结束的时间戳。单位为毫秒

TaskStartTime.description_en: The timestamp when the task actually starts. Unit: milliseconds
TaskStartTime.description_zh: 任务实际开始的时间戳。单位为毫秒

TaskStatus.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
1: Started.
2: Completed.
3: Failed.
4: Timed out
TaskStatus.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
1：已启动。
2：已完成。
3：已失败。
4：已超时

TaskStatusText.description_en:
The text object of the task status. Valid values:
INIT: Pending.
START: Started.
DISPATCH: Self-check command issued.
SUCCESS: Self-check completed.
FAIL: Execution failed.
TIMEOUT: Timed out
TaskStatusText.description_zh:
任务状态的文本对象。取值：
INIT：待启动。
START：已启动。
DISPATCH：自检命令已下发。
SUCCESS：自检完成。
FAIL：执行失败。
TIMEOUT：已超时
